questions.explanation_english: Under the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, when departmental or judicial proceedings are pending against a retiring government servant, the Head of the Department is the competent authority to sanction a provisional pension. key_facts: CCS (Pension) Rules provide guidelines for provisional pensions.
